_comment: OUTCOME LEDGER — append-only, one JSON object per line. Delivery writes it; the CRM reads it (crm/expansion.py) and never copies it. CORE: date (measurement date) · metric (short, STABLE name — renaming starts a new series and breaks the trend) · value · unit · baseline (the PRE-yourco number; required) · direction ("up"|"down" — which way is BETTER; required whenever lower is better) · module (one of the 8 pillars) · findingId (the audit.json finding this improves) · source (re-derivable) · note.

_value: VALUE IS NOT ONLY MONEY. Use valueKind + valueAmount + valuePeriod to record what was actually delivered: dollars | hours (given back) | errors (mistakes avoided) | count. Each kind rolls up in ITS OWN terms and is never blended. dollarImpact/dollarBasis stay OPTIONAL and are used only when someone can write the arithmetic — converting 14 hours a week into a dollar figure needs an hourly rate nobody agreed, so we do not invent one.

source: Aspire export, 30-day median vs the Audit baseline
